entry.title: Amendment 3 would raise the non-school homestead exemption from $51,411 to $250,000 by 2028.
entry.summary: Property Taxes: Maximum exempt assessed value for a qualifying homestead, non-school levies.

entry.title: At Pinellas County's 2025 average rate, the full exemption would cut a homestead's non-school taxes by $2,423 in 2028.
entry.summary: Property Taxes: Published illustration: additional exempt value over the 2026 maximum ($98,589 in 2027, $198,589 in 2028) at the 2025 countywide average...

entry.title: Renters get no homestead exemption. Rental and commercial property would get a 5% annual assessment cap instead of 10%.
entry.summary: Property Taxes: The assessment cap limits growth in assessed value, not tax bills or rents.

entry.title: Amendment 3 would reduce local non-school property tax revenue by an estimated $11.83 billion a year by 2031.
entry.summary: Property Taxes: Estimated reduction in local non-school property tax revenue by government type.

entry.title: The Legislature put Amendment 3 on the ballot by votes of 75-26 in the House and 30-9 in the Senate on June 2, 2026.
